site.subtitleZh: 從工具與基礎，走到組學、AI 與研究實務的完整雙語課程地圖
site.subtitleEn: A bilingual curriculum from foundations to omics, AI, and research practice

groups.taglineZh: 動手做之前先把工具備齊
groups.taglineEn: Build the toolchain before you build anything
groups.introZh: 進入生資前必備的工具棧：版本控制、Linux 命令列、Python 與 R 雙語環境。先把工具裝穩，後續所有課程才會有共同語言。
groups.introEn: The toolchain every bioinformatician needs first: version control, the Linux command line, and the Python + R working environments. Get the foundations stable so everything else can speak the same language.

groups.taglineZh: 從計算思維到資料科學流程
groups.taglineEn: From computational thinking to the data-science workflow
groups.introZh: 演算法、資料結構、計算思維與資料科學工作流；雙軌生資程式語言入門 (Python + R)。從這層開始，你會真的開始「寫」生資。
groups.introEn: Algorithms, data structures, computational thinking, and the data-science workflow — plus the parallel Python + R tracks. This is where you start actually writing bioinformatics code.

groups.taglineZh: 讀懂實驗，計算才有意義
groups.taglineEn: Understand the biology before computing on it
groups.introZh: 進入生資前不可省略的生物核心：細胞、分子、遺傳、生化與生理。實驗讀得懂，下游所有分析才有意義。
groups.introEn: The non-negotiable biology underlying every bioinformatics analysis: cells, molecules, genetics, biochemistry, and physiology.

groups.taglineEn: The mathematical core of data analysis
groups.introZh: 線性代數、機率統計、推論與定量資料分析。從手算 SVD 到 DESeq2 為什麼會成立，這一層把所有方法的黑盒打開來看。
groups.introEn: Linear algebra, probability, inference, and quantitative data analysis. From computing an SVD by hand to understanding why DESeq2 works.

groups.taglineZh: 把方法整合成完整視角
groups.taglineEn: Integrate methods into a complete view
groups.introZh: 序列比對、生物網路、生醫資訊、高通量分析、模擬與系統生物學。學完這層，大多數生資論文你都能讀進去。
groups.introEn: Sequence analysis, biological networks, biomedical informatics, high-throughput pipelines, simulation, and systems biology.

groups.taglineEn: The main battleground of modern bioinformatics
groups.introZh: 從 bulk / single-cell RNA-seq 到空間轉錄體、表觀、蛋白與多組學整合。從 FASTQ 一路推到生物發現的完整工作流。
groups.introEn: From bulk and single-cell RNA-seq to spatial transcriptomics, epigenomics, proteomics, and multi-omics — the full pipeline from FASTQ to biological discovery.

groups.taglineZh: 資料驅動模型的核心工具箱
groups.taglineEn: The core toolkit for data-driven models
groups.introZh: 傳統機器學習、深度學習、資料探勘、AI 概論與可解釋性 — 為生資情境量身打造，重點放在報告與評估的正確性。
groups.introEn: Classical ML, deep learning, data mining, and AI fundamentals — tailored for bioinformatics, with emphasis on correct evaluation and reporting.

groups.introZh: 生物基礎模型 (Geneformer / scGPT)、AI Agents、生醫大數據實務、AI 素養與評估方法。把最新一代 AI 工具安全且有效地用在研究上。
groups.introEn: Biological foundation models (Geneformer, scGPT), AI agents, biomedical big-data practice, and AI literacy.

groups.taglineZh: 把研究做扎實的軟硬本領
groups.taglineEn: The skills that make research stick
groups.introZh: 學術寫作、進階生資程式、生物影像分析、生醫工程概論。把分析能力轉化為可發表、可重現、可工程化的成果。
groups.introEn: Academic writing, advanced bioinformatics programming, bioimage analysis, and biomedical engineering — translating analysis ability into publishable, reproducible output.

subjects.descZh: 版本控制、分支、Pull Request、Issue、Actions 入門。
subjects.descEn: Version control, branches, pull requests, issues, and GitHub Actions.

subjects.descZh: Bash、SSH、SLURM、awk/sed 與 pipeline 思維。
subjects.descEn: Bash, SSH, SLURM, awk/sed, and the pipeline mindset.

subjects.descZh: 語法、NumPy、pandas、Biopython 基礎。
subjects.descEn: Syntax, NumPy, pandas, and Biopython basics.

subjects.descZh: tidyverse、ggplot2、Bioconductor 入門。
subjects.descEn: tidyverse, ggplot2, and a Bioconductor primer.

subjects.descZh: Wing 四支柱 × DS 工作流；20 章 + 200 題雙語題庫。
subjects.descEn: Wing's four pillars meet the DS workflow; 20 chapters + 200-Q bilingual quiz.

subjects.descZh: 演算法、資料結構、計算複雜度的入門概念。
subjects.descEn: Algorithms, data structures, and computational complexity.

subjects.descZh: 探索性分析、資料清洗、可視化與模型評估流程。
subjects.descEn: EDA, data cleaning, visualization, and model evaluation.

subjects.descZh: Python / R 雙軌、FASTA / FASTQ / VCF、Snakemake & Nextflow。
subjects.descEn: Parallel Python / R tracks, FASTA / FASTQ / VCF, Snakemake & Nextflow.

subjects.descZh: 胺基酸、蛋白質結構、酵素動力學、代謝路徑。
subjects.descEn: Amino acids, protein structure, enzyme kinetics, and metabolism.

subjects.descZh: 細胞、組織、生理系統的整體概覽。
subjects.descEn: An overview of cells, tissues, and physiological systems.

subjects.descZh: 演化、遺傳、生態與分子細胞的綜論。
subjects.descEn: Evolution, genetics, ecology, and a molecular-cellular overview.

subjects.descZh: 孟德爾遺傳、連鎖、突變、族群遺傳。
subjects.descEn: Mendelian inheritance, linkage, mutation, and population genetics.

subjects.descZh: DNA→RNA→蛋白質、訊號傳導、細胞週期。
subjects.descEn: DNA→RNA→protein, signaling pathways, and the cell cycle.

subjects.descZh: 20 章 / 6 區塊：向量 → 矩陣 → 子空間 → SVD/PCA → 生資應用。
subjects.descEn: 20 chapters / 6 blocks: vectors → matrices → subspaces → SVD/PCA → bioinformatics applications.

subjects.descZh: ODE/PDE、Lotka-Volterra、SIR、Turing、bifurcation。
subjects.descEn: ODE/PDE models, Lotka-Volterra, SIR, Turing patterns, and bifurcation.

subjects.descZh: qPCR / WB / ELISA / Flow → EDA / 檢定 / FDR / Effect size。
subjects.descEn: qPCR / WB / ELISA / Flow → EDA / testing / FDR / effect size.

subjects.descZh: 估計、假設檢定、貝氏推論、信賴區間。
subjects.descEn: Estimation, hypothesis testing, Bayesian inference, and confidence intervals.

subjects.descZh: 臨床試驗、存活分析、流行病學統計、檢力計算。
subjects.descEn: Clinical trials, survival analysis, epidemiological statistics, and power calculations.

subjects.descZh: 序列分析、比對、BLAST 與生資資料庫入門。
subjects.descEn: Sequence analysis, alignment, BLAST, and major bioinformatics databases.

subjects.descZh: PPI、GRN、共表達網路與社群偵測。
subjects.descEn: PPI, GRN, co-expression networks, and community detection.

subjects.descZh: 電子病歷、影像資料、本體論與臨床預測模型。
subjects.descEn: EHRs, imaging data, ontologies, and clinical prediction models.

subjects.descZh: FASTQ → counts → 多組學 → 基礎模型 → 重現性，20 章。
subjects.descEn: FASTQ → counts → multi-omics → foundation models → reproducibility, 20 ch.

subjects.descZh: Monte Carlo、SSA、agent-based、in silico 實驗設計。
subjects.descEn: Monte Carlo, SSA, agent-based, in silico experimentation.

subjects.descZh: 代謝模型、訊號網路、ODE 模擬與整合視角。
subjects.descEn: Metabolic models, signaling networks, ODE simulation, and an integrative view.

subjects.descZh: QC、對齊、計數、DESeq2 與富集分析的完整工作流。
subjects.descEn: QC, alignment, counting, DESeq2, and enrichment analysis end-to-end.

subjects.descZh: ChIP-seq、ATAC-seq、DNA 甲基化、Hi-C。
subjects.descEn: ChIP-seq, ATAC-seq, DNA methylation, and Hi-C.

subjects.descZh: WGS / WES、變異呼叫、CNV 與結構變異分析。
subjects.descEn: WGS / WES, variant calling, CNVs, and structural-variant analysis.

subjects.descZh: MOFA、iCluster、CCA 與跨模態整合方法。
subjects.descEn: MOFA, iCluster, CCA, and cross-modality integration methods.

subjects.descZh: 質譜流程、MaxLFQ、PTM 與定量分析。
subjects.descEn: Mass-spec workflows, MaxLFQ, PTMs, and quantitative proteomics.

subjects.descZh: Visium、Xenium、deconvolution 與空間統計。
subjects.descEn: Visium, Xenium, deconvolution, and spatial statistics.

subjects.descZh: mRNA、lncRNA、isoform 與剪接分析。
subjects.descEn: mRNA, lncRNA, isoforms, and splicing analysis.

subjects.descZh: QC、PCA、UMAP、分群、軌跡推論與 CellChat。
subjects.descEn: QC, PCA, UMAP, clustering, trajectory inference, and CellChat.

subjects.descZh: 符號 AI、搜尋、知識表示、規劃。
subjects.descEn: Symbolic AI, search, knowledge representation, and planning.

subjects.descZh: 關聯規則、分群、異常偵測、特徵工程。
subjects.descEn: Association rules, clustering, anomaly detection, and feature engineering.

subjects.descZh: CNN、RNN、Transformer 與訓練實務。
subjects.descEn: CNNs, RNNs, Transformers, and training in practice.

subjects.descZh: 監督 / 非監督學習、模型評估、SHAP 與可解釋性。
subjects.descEn: Supervised / unsupervised learning, evaluation, SHAP, interpretability.

subjects.descZh: Tool use、ReAct、planning 與 multi-agent 架構。
subjects.descEn: Tool use, ReAct, planning, and multi-agent architectures.

subjects.descZh: Prompt 工程、評估方法、偏誤與合規思維。
subjects.descEn: Prompt engineering, evaluation, bias, and compliance for biomedical AI.

subjects.descZh: TCGA / GTEx、生物基礎模型、跨組學 AI 整合。
subjects.descEn: TCGA / GTEx, biological foundation models, and cross-omics AI integration.

subjects.descZh: scGPT、Geneformer、scFoundation 等基礎模型。
subjects.descEn: scGPT, Geneformer, scFoundation, and other single-cell foundation models.

subjects.descZh: 論文結構、回應審稿、IMRaD、學術英文寫作。
subjects.descEn: Paper structure, peer-review response, IMRaD, and scientific English.

subjects.descZh: 效能、Rust / Cython、HPC、CI/CD。
subjects.descEn: Performance, Rust / Cython, HPC, and CI/CD for bioinformatics.

subjects.descZh: Fiji、QuPath、CellProfiler、Cellpose 與深度模型。
subjects.descEn: Fiji, QuPath, CellProfiler, Cellpose, and deep-learning models.

subjects.descZh: 生醫訊號、影像、醫材與法規概論。
subjects.descEn: Biomedical signals, imaging, devices, and regulatory basics.
